question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Initial
solution:
The correct answer is **"Terminal."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Initial"** means happening at the beginning; first. (प्रारंभिक; प्रथम)

 
 
• **Example**: *This is the initial stage of the plan.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of **Initial** is **Terminal.**
 
• **"Terminal"** means final or ultimate. (अंतिम या चरम)
 
 
• **Example**: *I met a patient in the **terminal**__ stages of their illness.*
 
 
 
• **Terminal** is the opposite of **Initial **in terms of starting and ending points.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Trivial** means unimportant or insignificant. (महत्वहीन, मामूली; नगण्य, तुच्‍छ)
 
• **Inaugural** means relating to the beginning or first occurrence of something. (उद्‌घाटन-संबंधी)
 
• **Fractional** means relating to or constituting a part or fraction of a whole. (संपूर्ण के किसी भाग या अंश से संबंधित या गठित करने वाला)
